name: Chloramphenicol Eye Drops/Ointment
dosing: Drops: 1 drop every 2 hours initially, reduce as infection controlled. Ointment: apply QDS and at bedtime
contraindications: Hypersensitivity, family history of aplastic anaemia (relative)
monitoring: Clinical response, prolonged use may need specialist review
pregnancy: Safe for topical ocular use - minimal systemic absorption
sideEffects: Transient stinging, hypersensitivity (rare), aplastic anaemia (extremely rare with topical)
clinicalPearls: Available OTC. First-line for bacterial conjunctivitis. Use drops during day, ointment at night. 5 days treatment usually sufficient
